exposure: 800 mg sublingual misoprostol for postpartum hemorrhage treatment
outcome: hemoglobin decrease of 20 g/L or greater from pre- to post-delivery assessment
cohort: Women who underwent home deliveries in Chitral district, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province, Pakistan, after presenting at healthcare facilities during the third trimester of pregnancy.
finding: There was no significant difference in the incidence of a 20 g/L or greater decrease in hemoglobin between those receiving 800 mg sublingual misoprostol and those receiving placebo for PPH treatment.
